newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Utd Tractors says '96 net 74.3 bln rph.
newsitem.headline: Utd Tractors says '96 net 74.3 bln rph.

text.p: Indonesian heavy equipment and mining contractor PT United Tractors said on Tuesday it posted net profit of around 74.3 billion rupiah in 1996 against 58.5 billion rupiah in 1995.

"The figures are not final yet, but we can say net profit for 1996 would be more or less around 74.3 billion rupiah, while in 1997 we expect to book a net profit of 92 billion rupiah," company director Frans Santoso told Reuters.
Santoso said he was optimistic the firm could achieve the 1997 target due to expected firm demand particularly from the country's mining industry.
